metadata.note: Baseline for benchmarks/check-graph-save.js (#3011). Row counts are deterministic and blocking; the ratio floors (rowReduction >= 1000x, speedup >= 3x under --strict-timing) are blocking; the absolute milliseconds are advisory unless --strict-timing is passed, because timing is not portable across machines or Node majors. Regenerate with: node benchmarks/bench-graph-save.js --json > benchmarks/graph-save-baseline.json
